title: 13-year-old Corbell hears Knapp's Lazar interview on the radio

tellings.quote: I've said this before, you know, I heard George Knapp's voice interviewing a guy named Bob Lazar on the radio.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says that around 1990, when he was 13, he heard a Las Vegas reporter, George Knapp, on the radio interviewing a man named Bob Lazar, who claimed to have worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site. Corbell tells this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels as the moment his interest began, the start of a path that he says led to his later work on the subject.
